title: Custom Neon Green Soccer Player Artwork Comforter Set, Boys Room Decor
description:
Inspire dreams of the field with this Jeminise Soccer Player Comforter Set, perfect for young soccer enthusiasts. This personalized bedding set features vibrant soccer designs, making it an ideal addition to any boy's room and a thoughtful gift for a soccer fan.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed for young soccer fans, inspiring them with their favorite sport and soccer stars.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with a name and number, creating a unique bedding set for your child.
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Environmentally friendly finishing process ensures fabric retains dye and prevents fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, with options for pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and can be air dried without heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design A4
Style Modern
Included Components Duvet Cover
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Customization 1 text input
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
